notes: acceptable_verdicts is a list, not a single value: any verdict in it counts as correct for this topic_id. evaluate_verdicts.py still records the exact verdict produced for the confusion matrix -- this list only controls what counts as correct.

A null acceptable_verdicts marks a topic this file does not score for verdict accuracy: sam_registration_active, pra_national_security_cooperation, kaspersky_telecom_prohibition_compliance, and submission_deadline_and_channel, since all four are is_text_verifiable: false in true_requirements.json and never get a verdict from a correctly-behaving pipeline.

The application deliberately varies its error types: compliant (11 topics), non_compliant across different failure shapes -- a missing field (part number/SKU), a wrong value (quote validity date, RAM capacity, warranty length), and a total omission (hot-swap bays, chassis dimensions) -- insufficient_information (vague/generic statements for pricing-inclusiveness and NVMe drive roles), and one contradictory claim (GPU model stated two different ways in the same quote).
description is copied verbatim from the matching topic_id in true_requirements.json so this file can be read alone; true_requirements.json is the source of truth if the two diverge.

verdicts.description: Only the exact brand-name products, models, and configurations identified in the RFQ and Attachment 1 are acceptable; alternate, substitute, equivalent, or “or equal” products will not be considered and will be rated Technically Unacceptable.
verdicts.rationale: Application certifies the quoted TALINO workstations are the exact brand-name SUMURI products required by this RFQ; no alternate/substitute product is offered.
